start.description:
Start datetime of the time range. The start date is inclusive of the date mentioned.
E.g. '2010-01-01T00:00:00' (everything starting from '2011-01-01T00:00:00' will be included)

end.description:
End datetime of the time range. The end date is exclusive of the date mentioned.
E.g. '2011-01-01T00:00:00' (everything before '2011-01-01T00:00:00' will be included)

name.description: The unique and required name of this instance.

typeIdent.description:
Indicates explicit sub-type of entry.  Composed of the concatenation of the typeKey of the instance's type and all
of its base type's typeIdent

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

parentCoordinator.description: Parent {@link MlWorkflowCoordinatable} that this result belongs to.

statusForCoordinatable.description:
Helper field for filtering during the coordinator implementation.
See {@link Workflow.Coordinatable} for status semantics.

canceledCount.description: Number of times the {@link #parentCoordinator} has canceled this result.

isCanceled.description:
True if the most recent execution of this result was canceled. This is used for quick filtering
to focus on canceled results.

errorCount.description:
Stores the count of errors that would be returned from {@link #errors}. This is used for quick filtering
to focus on results with errors.

run.description:
Reference to the {@link WorkflowExecutorRun} that executed the actions to execute this
result.

durationSeconds.description:
Duration in seconds of the most recent {@link #run} that executed the actions pertaining to this result.
This is used for quick filtering to focus on results with unexpected execution times (long or short).
This field is null if this result has not been executed.

pastRuns.description:
Reference to all past {@link WorkflowExecutorRun}s that executed the actions pertaining to this
result.

attemptedRecoveryCount.description: Number of times the {@link #parentCoordinator} has attempted to recover this result.

route.description:
the route that relates the {@link #model} to the {@link #subjects}. It also contains the handlers
used for the operation that was performed.

subjects.description: the subjects that this operation was performed on.

title: Holds metadata on an operation for an {@link MlModel}, as part of {@link MlSubject.OperationJob.Run}.
name: MlSubject.OperationJob.Result
